PAPERS.title: Decoupling between PM2.5 oxidative potential and light extinction: Roles of chemical composition and aerosol thermodynamic state
PAPERS.pm: Volume-normalised oxidative potential and light extinction placed on a common quadrant framework, with water-soluble organic carbon, aerosol liquid water content, aerosol pH and PMF source factors as explanatory terms
PAPERS.n: Two urban sites in southern Taiwan; paired OP and optical measurements, PMF source apportionment; sampling duration not stated in the abstract

PAPERS.title: Tower- and drone-based BVOC observations in a suburban Tokyo forest: methodological insights and MEGAN comparison
PAPERS.pm: Isoprene and monoterpene mixing ratios and emission fluxes at multiple heights on a 30 m flux tower, cross-checked by drone sampling and against MEGAN
PAPERS.n: Multi-year intermittent warm-season (May-Oct) campaign, Quercus serrata-dominated suburban Tokyo forest; drone sampling within 30 m of the tower

PAPERS.title: OAV-based source characterization of designated odor compounds in long-term continuous monitoring data with severe missingness
PAPERS.pm: 22 designated odour compounds at 20 min resolution; block-holdout imputation with BiLSTM, BiGRU, TCN, Transformer and HistGradientBoosting, then odour activity value and odour contribution
PAPERS.n: Three facilities (livestock farm, wastewater plant, anonymised organic-waste plant) in Eumseong, 1 Aug 2022-30 Jun 2023; multi-week to multi-month block gaps

PAPERS.title: Scale-dependent drivers shape airborne microbiomes across the Shanghai subway network
PAPERS.pm: Paired TSP (<=100 um) and PM2.5 sampling with microbial taxonomy, transcriptional potential, PM2.5 chemical composition, microclimate and network topology
PAPERS.n: 43 underground stations on 13 lines, stratified cluster sampling at entrances, halls and platforms

PAPERS.title: Biomass burning and African dust influence on seasonal aerosol chemistry over the Western Caribbean (Part I): Atmospheric variability and human health
PAPERS.pm: Continuous PM2.5, PM10 and particle-bound PAH with the PM2.5/PM10 ratio as a regime discriminator, joined to FIRMS fire detections and HYSPLIT back-trajectories
PAPERS.n: Near-coastal urban site, Merida, Mexico; contrast of the March-May biomass-burning season against the June-August African dust season

PAPERS.title: Influence of boundary layer conditions and surface properties on bacterial interaction with indoor built surfaces
PAPERS.pm: Attachment fraction and centrifugal detachment of Corynebacterium sp. on carpet, wood, metal and glass, with near-surface velocity fields by particle image velocimetry
PAPERS.n: Four surface materials; roughness, contact angle and porosity measured; batch attachment, centrifugal detachment and PIV. Replicate count not stated in the abstract

PAPERS.title: Transboundary biomass-burning influence on springtime PM2.5 population exposure across southern China during 2015-2019
PAPERS.pm: Population-weighted share of days above the WHO 2021 24 h guideline (15 ug/m3) and China GB 3095-2012 Grade II (75 ug/m3), with the Indo-China Peninsula fire contribution isolated by a paired GEOS-Chem run
PAPERS.n: 51 cities in Yunnan, Guangxi and Guangdong, March-April 2015-2019, gridded to WorldPop; GEOS-Chem at 2 deg x 2.5 deg

PAPERS.title: Residential gas combustion drives building-sector air pollution mortality in the U.S.
PAPERS.pm: CMAQ Decoupled Direct Method sensitivities of NO2, O3 and PM2.5 to building-sector precursor emissions, propagated through BenMAPR to premature deaths
PAPERS.n: Contiguous US, 2021 emissions year; 14,000 premature deaths/yr (95% CI 7,900-19,000), of which residential gas ~7,900

PAPERS.title: Incomplete reduction of particle-bound PAH toxicity under lower PM2.5 conditions: Evidence from Kunming, China
PAPERS.pm: 16 priority PM2.5-bound PAHs, BaP-equivalent burden, particle-normalised toxicity intensity (BaPeq/PM2.5) and incremental lifetime cancer risk, split by lower- and higher-PM2.5 stage
PAPERS.n: Kunming, China; two PM2.5 stages compared with covariate-adjusted models, PMF source patterns and RF-SHAP attribution

PAPERS.title: Investigating the impacts of abandoned oil and gas wells on indoor air quality and health symptoms in Ontario, Canada: A pilot study
PAPERS.pm: 13 passively sampled indoor VOCs (gas phase, not particulate) against inverse-distance-squared-weighted abandoned-well exposure within 3 km, with self-reported acute symptoms
PAPERS.n: Two rounds in southwestern Ontario: 17 households Oct 2024, 15 households Feb-Mar 2025

PAPERS.title: From complaint-driven response to preventive management: Strengthening indoor air quality management in Malaysian buildings
PAPERS.pm: Argues for routine indoor monitoring of particulate matter and outdoor-to-indoor transport alongside CO2, rather than complaint-triggered investigation under ICOP IAQ 2010
PAPERS.n: Single-author commentary on a non-peer-reviewed platform; cites Malaysian office, hospital and school studies but presents no primary data

PAPERS.title: Early-life exposure to particulate matter and green spaces: Associations with infant growth
PAPERS.pm: Perinatal PM10 and PM2.5 from the RIO detrended-kriging interpolation model; municipal vegetation split into low, high and total green space
PAPERS.n: 119,110 Flemish children; BMI-, length- and head-circumference-for-age z-scores from well-baby clinic records, mixed models with a 5-df age spline

PAPERS.title: Prenatal exposure to PM2.5 components and fetal growth: identifying critical gestational weeks and key toxic components in a Chinese birth cohort
PAPERS.pm: Weekly black carbon, organic matter, nitrate, sulfate and ammonium from the TAP real-time exposure model, entered into distributed lag models with GEE plus ML mixture analysis
PAPERS.n: 2,680 mother-newborn pairs, 9,339 ultrasound measurements (AC, HC, FL, EFW), Guangzhou 2017-2020

PAPERS.title: Associations of PM2.5 components, residential greenness, and heatwaves with incident venous thromboembolism
PAPERS.pm: Elemental carbon, organic matter, sulfate, ammonium and nitrate at 3x3 km; NDVI in a 300 m buffer; heatwaves under several temperature thresholds
PAPERS.n: 483,610 UK Biobank participants (mean age 56.5, 54.3% female), median 11.83 y follow-up, 9,988 incident VTE

PAPERS.title: Joint association of air pollutants and lifestyles on early-/late-onset heart failure: a population-based prospective cohort study
PAPERS.pm: Composite air-pollution score over NO2, NOx, PM10, PM2.5 and PM2.5-10, crossed with a six-component lifestyle score; multiplicative and additive interaction
PAPERS.n: 233,341 UK Biobank participants, 2006-2010 baseline, followed to 2023; results split by early- and late-onset heart failure

PAPERS.title: Ozone and possible heat effects on out-of-hospital cardiac arrest: a time-series study
PAPERS.pm: Daily mean temperature over lag 0-14 in a quasi-Poisson DLNM, plus lag0-1 PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO and O3 in single- and two-pollutant models
PAPERS.n: 7,996 OHCA cases from the Tianjin prehospital emergency system, July 2023-June 2024 (mean 21.9/day)

PAPERS.title: Long-term exposure to multiple air pollution and trajectory risk of cardio-renal-metabolic multimorbidity
PAPERS.pm: Not retrievable: the publisher deposited no abstract to Crossref, Europe PMC or Semantic Scholar at index time
PAPERS.n: Not stated (metadata only)

PAPERS.title: Short-term effects of ambient PM2.5 on respiratory healthcare utilisation in older adults: a time-series study in an industrialising area of Central Thailand
PAPERS.pm: Daily PM2.5 from the nearest government monitor, single-lag and moving-average negative binomial models per 10 ug/m3
PAPERS.n: 924 respiratory visits (ICD-10 J00-J99, mean 6.37/day) among residents aged >=60 within 5 km of a new industrial area, Nov 2023-Mar 2024; mean PM2.5 42.43 ug/m3 (SD 15.12)

PAPERS.title: PM10 exposure impairs differentiation and induces inflammation in human small airway epithelial cells cultured at the air-liquid interface
PAPERS.pm: Repeated PM10 dosing of differentiated air-liquid-interface cultures; TEER, lineage markers, surfactant proteins, cytokines, Notch and NF-kB signalling
PAPERS.n: Human small airway epithelial ALI cultures exposed for 7, 14 and 21 days; PM10 dose and donor number not stated in the abstract

PAPERS.title: Unveiling particulate matter-lung interactions from static models to dynamic lung-on-chips
PAPERS.pm: Compares 2D culture, 3D bioprinted constructs, organoids and lung-on-chip platforms for reproducing PM deposition and breath-mimicking mechanical strain
PAPERS.n: Review; no primary data. Model-by-model appraisal of strengths and limitations

PAPERS.title: Welding fume exposure and respiratory innate immune activation: metal-rich particles, inflammatory biomarkers, and immune-informed occupational prevention
PAPERS.pm: Metal-rich fine and ultrafine welding-fume particles as a stimulus to airway epithelium, alveolar macrophages, neutrophils and circulating immune cells
PAPERS.n: Mini review spanning human exposure studies, controlled inhalation, cell models and workplace investigations; no pooled estimate

PAPERS.title: Mechanistic pathways of biochemical and toxicological responses to waste tyre combustion emissions: A systematic review
PAPERS.pm: Particulate matter, PAHs, VOCs and heavy metals from open waste-tyre burning, mapped to organ-specific biochemical and toxicological endpoints
PAPERS.n: PubMed, Scopus, ScienceDirect and Google Scholar, 2016-2025; SYRCLE, JBI and NIH appraisal; heterogeneity precluded pooling

PAPERS.title: Association between PM2.5 constituents and non-suicidal self-injury among Chinese adolescents: modifying role of biological rhythm
PAPERS.pm: PM2.5 total mass and constituents in logistic and weighted quantile sum regression, stratified by multidimensional biological-rhythm score
PAPERS.n: 18,398 adolescents in grades 7-12 across 15 schools in four provinces; ANSAQ for NSSI, SBRDA for rhythm disorder

PAPERS.title: Climate factors, air pollutants, and extreme events shape influenza risk in China: a hospital-based case-crossover and machine-learning study
PAPERS.pm: Exposure-lag-response for meteorology, air pollution and compound extreme events by DLNM, variable ranking by ML, and an LSTM forecasting proof of concept for Beijing
PAPERS.n: 630,120 influenza-positive cases from hospitals in 335 Chinese cities, 2005-2019

PAPERS.title: Spatiotemporal co-occurrence patterns and related risk factors of esophageal and lip and oral cavity cancers among older adults across 203 countries and territories
PAPERS.pm: Occupational exposure to particulate matter, gases and fumes as one of 25 country-level exposures in negative binomial models with population offsets
PAPERS.n: GBD 2021, adults >=55 y, 203 countries and territories, 1990-2021; 58 candidate exposures screened to 36 by random forest and SHAP, then 25 after VIF

PAPERS.title: Age-dependent heterogeneity trends in the associations between urban green space and cardiovascular health in a humid-subtropical megacity
PAPERS.pm: Two-stage gradient-boosting plus structural equation model; air-quality pathways (NO2, SO2, PM2.5) carry >75% of the relative contribution to model variance
PAPERS.n: Clinical cohort of 23,312 patients in Nanjing; age-stratified canopy-density x PM2.5 slopes reported as nonsignificant with very small effect sizes

PAPERS.title: Combined effects of face mask blocking, filtration, and ventilation strategy on exhaled air transmission and infection risk
PAPERS.pm: Not retrievable: the publisher deposited no abstract to Crossref, Europe PMC or Semantic Scholar at index time
PAPERS.n: Not stated (metadata only)
